verdict.rationale: Box publishes its own API reference at developer.box.com/reference with runnable examples, such as a curl call to /users/me that works once you insert a developer token. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive in-browser explorer, and the probe found no public OpenAPI spec at any common path. Missing for 10: an interactive try-it console in the reference, runnable examples documented across endpoints beyond a single curl snippet, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Replace <ACCESS_TOKEN> with a developer token and run: curl https://api.box.com/2.0/users/me
